title: Fairy Forest Healing
opening: Dark energy has crept into the Fairy Forest and the glow has gone out. Your wand still holds fairy light. Heal the five forest places one by one!
not_yet: Not yet! That part of the forest isn't ready. Follow the clue.

steps.clue: Where the Old Oak sits so still, a patch of forest, cold and ill. Wave your wand and watch it gleam!
The Oak is healed, but hear the plea: the Mushroom Ring needs you and me. Find where the little caps grow round.
Two are healed, three more to go. The darkest place is the Cave, you know. Creep up quiet, hold wand high!
Halfway home, the fairies cheer, but the Waterfall still hides fear. Bring your light where water falls.
One last place the darkness keeps, where the Fairy Throne silently sleeps. Heal it now with all your might!

ending: The Fairy Forest is healed! Every tree and flower glows again because of you. The fairies name you Guardian of the Forest!
